description: This Java class, ChartHelper, provides UI components and methods to create 3D surface plots and related controls within a Java Swing application, specifically for visualizing XY data in a 3D surface plot with functionalities like save image and range configuration.

classes.name: ChartHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate and manipulate 3D surface plots for XY data in a Swing UI context.

methods.name: create3DControl
methods.description: Creates a JPanel containing a 3D surface plot viewer with controls for saving images and adjusting RPM and Y values.

methods.name: createDefaultSurfaceModel
methods.description: Overloaded methods to create a DefaultSurfaceModel for surface plotting from XYData, with options for specifying range and additional data.

methods.name: setYRange
methods.description: Sets the Y range for the surface model.
